extension.description: A compact Git bottom panel for VS Code with an IDEA-style changelist, diff, and commit workflow.
config.diffTarget.description: Where to open file diffs. The VS Code editor is the default; the GitLoom panel keeps diffs inside the bottom panel.
config.diffTarget.editor: Open file diffs in the VS Code editor.
config.diffTarget.panel: Open file diffs in the GitLoom panel.
config.fileLayout.description: How to display changed files and commit detail files.
config.fileLayout.tree: Group files by directory with collapsible folders.
config.fileLayout.flat: List files flat with their full paths.
config.historyLimit.description: Number of commits to load at once.
config.pullStrategy.description: Strategy for updating the project. Fast-forward only by default to avoid unexpected merge commits.
